fields.notes: DALI is a published protocol specification (IEC 62386) — no PDK, floor-plan, SDC, UPF, or DFT artifact at the protocol level. SLAA422A uses MSP430F2131 / G2xx2 integrated peripherals; any implementing IP/chip ships its own physical-design collateral.
